from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, cast
from rich.style import StyleType

        Console,
        ConsoleOptions,
        JustifyMethod,

        collapse: bool = False


class Table(RichTable):

        header_style: StyleType = None,
        footer_style: StyleType = None,
        style: StyleType = None,
